articles.title: Michigan farmer protects his family’s 131 acres from future housing development
articles.description: Michigan farmer John Boyer bought back his family’s 131 acres after the land changed hands over decades. In 2026, he sold its development rights to the Little Traverse Conservancy through a conservation easement, ensuring the property cannot be divided for housing or commercial development. Boyer hopes the farmland remains protected for generations.

articles.title: Mirzapur Movie Review and Release Live Updates
articles.full_text: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' is positioned as a standalone prequel. Its story is set between episodes 6 and 7 of Season 1, which premiered in 2018. 'Mirzapur: The Movie' is expected to make a strong start at the Indian box office, with early projections suggesting an opening-day collection of around Rs 25 crore net. If the film meets these estimates, it could challenge 'Awarapan 2' for the fourth-biggest Hindi film opening of 2026. The Emraan Hashmi-starrer, which emerged as a recent box-office success, opened at around Rs 22 crore net in the Hindi market after recording approximately Rs 8.50 crore in gross advance bookings for its opening day. 'Mirzapur: The Movie', meanwhile, had already clocked around Rs 6.50 crore in advance bookings by 8 pm, with final pre-release sales expected to potentially reach levels comparable to 'Awarapan 2'. The film also has an advantage as it coincides with the Janmashtami holiday, potentially driving significant spot bookings and walk-in audiences. Although the film carries an adult certification, its strong franchise following could work in its favour. The highly anticipated 'Mirzapur: The Movie' has been cleared by the censor board with hardly any modifications. A source close to the film shared that 'Mirzapur: The Movie' has been certified by the CBFC with 'hardly any modifications', retaining all the raw elements intended by the makers. The sources further said, "This means audiences will get to experience the much-awaited theatrical adaptation exactly the way the makers intended it to be seen, retaining its raw, unfiltered essence on the big screen." Going by the reports, 35 seconds of footage had been cut from the movie by the board. However, the source claims that no cuts have been made to the film and very few modifications have been suggested. For Shweta, the transition is a testament to the enduring love audiences have shown the series over the years and the emotional investment theyâve made in its characters. She further mentioned, âThatâs why Mirzapur becoming one of the first major Indian streaming franchises to make the leap to the big screen feels so special. Itâs not just a film adaptation. Itâs the result of years of audience love. Every season ended with people wanting more, revisiting the show, discussing theories and carrying these characters with them. In many ways, this film belongs to the fans as much as it belongs to usâ. The actress also said that the film also represents the continuation of her character, Golu Guptaâs deeply layered journey, a character she has inhabited for nearly a decade. âWhat makes me particularly emotional is Goluâs journey. Iâve lived with her for years. She began as a young woman who believed in doing the right thing and gradually transformed into someone navigating power, grief, revenge and ambition. Watching audiences grow alongside her has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career. Even today, I meet young women who tell me they connected with her resilience, her flaws and her refusal to fit into expectations. Thatâs incredibly movingâ, she added. Actress Shweta Tripathi, who is gearing up for the release of her upcoming film âMirzapur: The Filmâ, has spoken up about the journey of her character in the franchise. The actress shared that her character has covered a great deal of arc as she evolved from someone who believes in doing the right thing to navigating power, grief, revenge and ambition. What began as a gritty crime drama on streaming has evolved into a cultural phenomenon, with characters, dialogues and moments becoming deeply embedded in popular culture. The streaming show has further expanded to cinematic canvas, and is waiting in the wings for the release. Reflecting on the journey of the show, Shweta said, âWhen we started shooting Mirzapur almost eight years ago, none of us could have predicted the journey it would take. As actors, you hope your work connects with people, but very rarely does a show become part of everyday conversations, memes, celebrations and even the language people use. Mirzapur did that. It made us their Guddu Bhaiya and Golu Didi. Today, people donât just watch the show, they care about the characters and root for themâ. The makers of âMirzapur: The Movieâ unveiled character posters of its iconic characters of Munna Bhaiya, Guddu Bhaiya and Kaleen Bhaiya on Wednesday. Carrying the message, âGaddi Hai Toh Hum Hainâ, the posters revisit the power, legacy and rivalries that have defined the Mirzapur universe, instantly sparking excitement among fans. Taking to their social media, the makers revealed Kaleen Bhaiya's (played by Pankaj Tripathi) first-Look character Poster and wrote, âJo aaya hai, woh jaayega bhi, bas marzi Kaleen Bhaiya ki hogi. Aapka swagat karte hain bade parde par. #MirzapurTheMovie, teaser out tomorrow at 12PM. Set a reminder and be the first ones to watch the teaserâ. Sharing Guddu Bhaiya's (played by Ali Fazal) character poster, the makers wrote, âShuru majboori mein kiye the, ab maja aa raha hai. Guddu Bhaiya aa rahe hain bade parde par, taiyaar hain na? #MirzapurTheMovie, teaser out tomorrow at 12PM. Set a reminder and be the first ones to watch the teaserâ. The makers also revealed Munna Bhaiya's (played by Divyenndu) character poster and wrote, "Hindi philam ke hero hain hum, kaha tha na, hum amar hain. Munna Bhaiya ka bhaukaal, ab bade parde par. #MirzapurTheMovie, teaser out tomorrow at 12PM. Set a reminder and be the first ones to watch the teaser. Watch #MirzapurTheMovie only in cinemas in Hindi & Telugu". Actor Pankaj Tripathi shared a hilarious story regarding 'Mirzapur: The Movie's new song 'Sajanva' at the music launch of the film. At the event, Pankaj Tripathi shared a hilarious story about how he discovered the song 'Sajanva' from the upcoming film Mirzapur. When asked about his favourite song from the movie's album, the actor said he was impressed by the new songs in the film. Pankaj Tripathi said, "I have to share an interesting story. A few days ago, my wife saw a reel, and it had a Sajanva song in the background. It was a reel featuring me, which was made by paps. So, my wife asked me about the song, and I asked her to Google it since I was also not aware of it. As I said that, my daughter looked at both of us in surprise and told us that the song is from Mirzapur: The Movie." The album launch of Mirzapur featured the performance of singers Rashmeet Kaur, Romy, Dhanda Nyoliwala and others on new songs including Varoon Forever, Saason Ki Mala (new rendition), Do Numbari and Ghoom Ghoom. The event was attended by the whole cast of the film, including Ravi Kishan, Sonal Chauhan, Divyendu, Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi, Jitendra, Shweta Tripathi, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Rasika Duggal and others. Actor Shweta Tripathi has started shooting for "Mirzapur: The Movie" in Varanasi. Excited to reprise her role of Golu, Shweta in a press note said, "Golu is not just a character for me; she has been a companion, a part of my life for so many years. To see her journey unfold on the big screen is overwhelming and surreal. Benaras is like my second home; it is so special because so many of my milestones are connected to this city." She added, "From Masaan to Mirzapur seasons 1 and 2, from Escape Live to Kalkoot, every project here has given me something unforgettable. My trainer, Tridev Pandey, who is like a brother to me, is also from Benaras, which makes it even more personal. This beautiful city of worship keeps calling me back, and I keep returning for its people, its food, and the love it has always given me." âHereâs just my love for the main man behind us.. pushing us to perfection DIRECTOR SAAB â Gurupa.. @gurmmeetsingh aur unke saathi in crime #PuneetKrishna for creating the many worlds and Baba @kapoorbaba who has relentlessly shot this masterpiece without compromising despite all the necessary hurdlesâ¦ but through all of it we brought our A game when the camera rolled up on usâ, he added. Set against the violent, power-hungry backdrop of Uttar Pradeshâs underworld, âMirzapurâ aims to capture the raw energy and intense clashes over crime, politics and legacy that made the original series a cultural phenomenon.

articles.title: Shweta Singh Kirti reacts to CBI probe in Disha Salian case
articles.description: The Bombay High Court has ordered a CBI investigation into Disha Salian's death. Sushant Singh Rajput's sister Shweta Singh Kirti expressed renewed hope for clarity. Disha Salian died in June 2020, followed by Sushant Singh Rajput six days later. Her father had sought a fresh probe into the circumstances surrounding her demise. The court directed the CBI to register an FIR and conduct a detailed investigation.
